c.tagline: Africa's diplomatic capital atop the Rift Valley highlands.

taxi.fareNote: Most street taxis (shared or contract) negotiate a fare before departure since many lack working meters; ride-hailing apps (RIDE, Feres) show a fixed app-calculated price upfront.

emergency.note: Response times can be slow; ask your hotel to help coordinate, and for serious issues use a private clinic (e.g., Bethzatha, CURE, or Landmark General Hospital) or contact your embassy.

hood_landmark.Bole: Edna Mall, Bole Road, Addis Ababa
hood_landmark.Piassa: Saint George Cathedral, Piassa, Addis Ababa

avoid.reason: Pickpocketing around the Merkato market and on minibuses; caution at night

hood_desc: The city's modern hub of high-rises, malls, restaurants, and nightlife, minutes from the airport; best for business travelers and first-time visitors wanting convenience.
Addis Ababa's diplomatic and UN quarter, home to the African Union and UNECA compounds and many business hotels; suits conference-goers, NGO staff, and diplomats.
The historic old town with Italian-era arcaded buildings, Merkato-adjacent markets, and budget guesthouses; ideal for backpackers, history buffs, and photographers.
Central business core anchored by Meskel Square, with luxury hotels, the National Museum, and easy light-rail access; good for travelers wanting a central, walkable-ish base.
A quieter, leafy residential and embassy area popular with expats and longer-stay visitors, with boutique hotels and good restaurants away from downtown bustle.

water.note: Tap water is unreliable and often contaminated; drink bottled or boiled water only.

transit.pay: For the light rail, buy a paper ticket at the station window before entering the platform (distance-based fares of about 2-6 ETB). City buses are paid in cash to the conductor onboard. Ride-hailing apps like RIDE and Feres charge a fixed in-app fare.
transit.hours: Light rail and most city buses run roughly 06:00-22:00 daily; there is no late-night public transit, so use taxis or ride-hailing apps after dark.
transit.note: Rush-hour traffic is heavy; the light rail's two lines (Green: east-west, Blue: north-south) are often faster than buses or taxis for cross-town trips.

transit.m: Anbessa public bus into downtown (board just outside the terminal, ~25-40 min)

tip.r: A 10% tip is appreciated at restaurants when no service charge is included; rounding up is common for taxis; not expected for small everyday purchases.
